task_title: Unify merchant/shop UX onto one shared shop system

plan_review.notes: Reviewer endorsed the boundary (share offer/presentation contract, keep panel+modal surfaces). Blocking concerns adopted: (1) collapse overlapping booleans into one discriminated availability state; (2) preserve each Floor-1 flow's current empty/unpurchasable behavior via an explicit policy rather than a blanket decline. Non-blocking adopted: forward ModalPicker kind unchanged (spell-broker automation contract); keep the model presentation-only (no re-derived eligibility, authoritative purchase stays in core/game callbacks); add deterministic coverage for the three Floor-1 adapters plus panel wording.
